title: Use GPT2 image to generate your character and keyframe storyboard before video…
content:
Use GPT2 image to generate your character and keyframe storyboard before video generation  
Generate the video with Seedance 2.0 via the CapCut/Dreamina AI mobile app  
Use Suno to create background music for the video  
Finish the project in CapCut Pro by adding text animation, sound effects, stickers, and final polish

es.content:
---

Usa Suno para crear música de fondo para el video  
Termina el proyecto en CapCut Pro añadiendo animación de texto, efectos de sonido, stickers y retoques finales  
---
